info.title: Core Admin API
info.description: Core Admin — the platform operator console's own API (operator bearer token, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`). This is not a third-party integration surface; see `/docs/api` for that.

post.description:
Creates a new delivery row and queues it for immediate delivery; the
original dead row is kept for audit. Requires `webhooks:replay`.
post.summary: Replay a dead webhook delivery as a fresh attempt

post.description:
Polls `checkStatus()` on a small batch of payments stuck in a
non-terminal status, applying any status change through the same
path an inbound webhook uses. Requires `payments:reconcile:write`.
post.summary: Trigger an on-demand payment reconciliation run

get.description:
Optionally scoped to an `organization_id`. Every other project-scoped
admin listing (payments, wallets, notifications) starts from a
`project_id` found here. Requires `projects:read`.

post.description:
Requires `projects:write` (covered by Platform Admin's `*`
wildcard). Audits internally — `identity` has `audit` module access.
post.summary: Create a project under an organization

get.summary: List a Project's wallets, with their current balance

post.description:
Requires `projects:write` (covered by Platform Admin's `*`
wildcard). Audits internally — `identity` has `audit` module access.

The plaintext password is returned once in this response and never
stored — the same one-shot-secret pattern as API key issuance and
the `identity:create-operator` CLI command, which this endpoint is
a self-service alternative to. Requires `operators:write` (Platform
Admin only). MFA enrollment happens on first login, not here.

put.description:
Never touches credentials or MFA state — those are separate flows.
Requires `operators:write` (Platform Admin only). Audits internally
— `identity` has `audit` module access. Returns 204 — the port
returns void.

post.description:
Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked operator succeeds without
effect. Requires `operators:write` (Platform Admin only). A
revoked operator's existing bearer tokens are rejected on their
very next request (`ResolveOperatorFromBearerToken` re-checks
revocation every time), so this takes effect immediately.

Requires `provider-applications:write`. `payment` cannot depend on
`audit` (module graph), so this controller records the audit entry
itself after calling the port — the private key is never included.
post.summary:
Register (or rotate) a Project's application/merchant-account with a
payment provider

get.description:
Requires `payments:reconcile:write` — the same permission
`TriggerPaymentReconciliationController` uses, since seeing what
would be touched is part of the same operator capability.
get.summary: Preview payments currently stuck in a non-terminal status

post.description:
Returns a short-lived challenge token and a `purpose` telling the
caller which endpoint to call next — `mfa_enrollment` on first login,
`mfa` once MFA is already enabled.
post.summary: Step 1 of operator login: verify email and password

post.description:
Generates a TOTP secret for the operator identified by the login
challenge, and returns it with a provisioning URI plus a fresh
challenge token for the confirmation step.

Verifies the TOTP code against the secret `mfa/enroll` generated. On
success, MFA becomes enabled and a Sanctum access token is issued.
post.summary: Confirm MFA enrollment and issue the access token

post.description:
Used once MFA is already enabled (`purpose: "mfa"` from the login
step). On success, issues a Sanctum access token.
post.summary: Step 2 of a returning operator's login: verify the TOTP code

get.description:
Resolves the bearer token and returns which operator it belongs to
and their role. The first call an operator console session should
make to confirm its token.

post.description: The token in the `Authorization` header stops working immediately.
post.summary: Revoke the operator's current access token

code.description:
min/max mirror the web form's equivalent field (security
review finding — this used to have no upper bound, an
oversized-payload gap on a public, throttle-only endpoint).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
